scope: Supplementary ROI-only CPU inference. These are not full-frame FROC results; samples not random. Two dev examples selected for opposite Mraw/Mint outcomes at anchor 9.
geometry: 64x64 native core via frozen core_prediction, same decoder/sampler halos and 256/81 chunking as 6000-step dev evaluation. Origin selected to center the annotated region. Derived from 17 consecutive original inputs for each output center. No resizing of inputs.
local_peak_accounting: Extract candidates from full 64x64 ROI using project _frame_peaks; include only local maxima in the displayed central 56x56 region. For a GT within the region, any accepted peak within Euclidean distance <=3 px is a local hit; select closest among eligible matches. Frame-wide false positives are outside the scope of this evaluation.
threshold_origin: Each model uses the threshold previously determined from the 32-center, step-6000 development monitoring population at 1 FP/output frame.
